_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Science and Technologies Protection Implementation Plan (S&TPIP)
summary: Requires contractors to describe the precise methods and mechanisms implemented to protect identified essential technology elements and enabling technologies regardless of location.
use_relationship:
The Science and Technologies Protection Implementation Plan (S&TPIP) is required to provide a description of the precise methods and mechanisms implemented to protect identified essential technology elements and enabling technologies regardless of the location where the work is being executed.

This Data Item Description contains the format, content, and intended use information for preparation instructions for the S&TPIP resulting from the program protection requirements set forth in DODI 5000.83, "Technology and Program Protection to Maintain Technological Advantage."
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Science and Technologies Protection Implementation Plan (S&TPIP) shall be contractor format unless a template is provided in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content:
The report shall contain the following:

i. Cover page to include Program Name and Contract Number
ii. Classification Markings, Distribution and Control Markings
iii. Signature/Approvals
iv. Change Record Table
v. Reference Document(s) to include related security classification guide(s) (SCG) or other authoritative documents
vi. Update Frequency
vii. Table of Contents
viii. Introduction and/or purpose of the document
ix. Methodologies
x. Critical technology elements and enabling technologies
xi. Threats
xii. Vulnerabilities
xiii. Countermeasures
xiv. Summary

Additional sections to consider:

i. Contract specific information and measures
ii. List of vendors and sub-contractors involved in the effort
iii. Locations
iv. Communication
v. Training
vi. Critical Information/Technology Compartmentalization
vii. Transportation
viii. Limitations
ix. Risk
x. Foreign Nationals and Green Card Holders
xi. Export Controls
xii. Public Release
xiii. Travel
xiv. Meetings
xv. Cyber
xvi. Cloud
xvii. Software/Hardware
xviii. Storage
xix. Telecommunication
xx. Encryption
xxi. Counterfeit Parts or Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM)
xxii. End of Contract/Effort Process
xxiii. Destruction of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI)
xxiv. Disposition
xxv. Approvals
xxvi. Waivers

children.title: Introduction Section
children.content:
This Data Item Description is generated by the contract which contains the specific and discrete requirement for implementation of a government Science and Technology Protection Plan (S&TPP). The contractor developed S&TPIP is a deliverable to the U.S. Government that details how the contractor will implement the Government prescribed S&TPP. The S&TPIP provides the principal communication and documented approaches from the contractor for Validation/Assessment and approval by the Department of Defense (DoD) or Component Program Manager, or Science and Technology Manager regarding contractor methods to: (a) identify the processes chosen to implement the S&TPP at contractor, sub-contractor, vendor-controlled and testing locations; and, (b) provide protection inputs to the system, technology and research throughout the acquisition lifecycle process. The ultimate purpose is for the performer to provide a method to ensure effective and efficient protection of essential technology elements and enabling technologies regardless of their location. The proactive assessments and implementation down to the root levels help ensure that a layered protection strategy is enabled, safeguarding against potential threats and reducing risks to critical assets, information, and technologies. By employing advanced security and technological measures, the U.S. Government will be able to enhance its ability to identify vulnerabilities and respond effectively to emerging threats, risks or problems.

The S&TPIP will be marked with the appropriate classification marking but will be at a minimum as Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). Depending on the specific information, details, or science/technology involved, the S&TPIP may be classified and must be handled and marked accordingly. Consult DoD or the relevant component cognizant security office prior to assembling/aggregating or sending any information involved with a S&TPP. It is intended that all requirements contained herein shall apply to all RDT&E with critical technologies/research and a S&TPP or similar document.
